title: BioLLMAgent: A Hybrid Framework with Enhanced Structural Interpretability for Simulating Human Decision-Making in Computational Psychiatry

live_model.evidence: Sec. IV.A: 'LLM API calls used fixed parameters (T=0.5, top-p p=0.9) with model versions GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13) and DeepSeek-V3.'

prompt.location: Appendix A.1 (Neutral Prior Prompt: [System]/[Task]/[Instruction]/[Output] blocks) and A.2 (CBT prompt)
prompt.note: Additional conditions (Noisy Control, Community Education) are in an online supplement.

claim.metric: KL divergence of the LLM action distribution from uniform, with the uniform-selection instruction
claim.location: Table V, row GPT-4o w/ (Chi-sq p 0.988, KL 0.002, Std 0.017)

data.source: Six public IGT datasets (N=350 participants; Ahn et al., Horstmann et al., Kjome et al., Maia & McClelland); code and anonymized data promised on GitHub/Zenodo

notes: The headline number (Table VI: GPT-4o T=0.5 MSD=1.00 across 6 datasets) requires the full hybrid ORL+LLM framework with PyMC inference, i.e. code. Only the prompt-ablation statistics (Table V) are LLM-only, and the number of sampled calls behind them is not stated.

resolution.plan: Table V's 'w/' row is LLM-only: the Appendix A.1 neutral-prior prompt with the uniform-selection instruction ('choose uniformly among decks A-D over 100 trials'), run on gpt-4o-2024-05-13 at T=0.5, top-p 0.9, without the ORL/PyMC loop. Sample deck choices, pool the distribution, and compute the chi-square p-value against uniform, the KL divergence from uniform and the std of deck proportions; compare with KL 0.002 (p 0.988, std 0.017).
resolution.approximation: The number of simulated participants/trials behind Table V is unstated; use a fixed budget (e.g. 30 x 100 choices), report n, and treat KL <= 0.01 as agreement since KL scales with sample size.
